def restored(I, bi, bj, h=4, w=4):
    n=len(I)
    cands={}
    def add(name, g): cands.setdefault(name, g)
    # vertical mirror of the counterpart block
    cj0=n-(bj+w)
    add('vmir', [list(r) for r in zip(*[I[i][cj0:cj0+w][::-1] for i in range(bi,bi+h)])])
    # horizontal mirror counterpart rows
    ri0=n-(bi+h)
    add('hmir', [I[i][bj:bj+w] for i in range(ri0,ri0+h)][::-1])
    # 180
    add('rot180', [I[i][cj0:cj0+w][::-1] for i in range(ri0,ri0+h)][::-1])
    # transpose counterparts
    add('transpose', [[I[bj+k][bi+r] for k in range(w)] for r in range(h)])
    add('adiag', [[I[n-1-(bj+k)][n-1-(bi+r)] for k in range(w)] for r in range(h)][::-1])
    return cands
